name: Instagram Guide
strategic_objective: Curated education, evergreen discovery, and structured storytelling through collections of existing posts.

tone: Helpful, authoritative, and clearly structured. More editorial than conversational, but still accessible.
copywriting_rules: The guide title must clearly communicate the benefit or outcome. The introduction should set expectations about what the user will learn or find inside. Each entry should add context to the original post rather than repeat it.
Title: benefit-driven and explicit. Intro: 2–4 short lines explaining what the guide includes and who it is for. Entry descriptions: 1–2 concise lines adding context or takeaway.
Guides are not primarily discovery-driven via hashtags. Rely more on profile traffic and cross-promotion.
Tag creators, partners, or brands only when they are central to the guide’s content.

required_generation_elements: Clear guide title with a defined outcome
At least one clear CTA to save or follow
hard_constraints: Unstructured post collections with no narrative logic
Repeating original captions without added context
Overloading the guide with unrelated topics
